info.title: ae/presence
info.description: Who is present, who has gone quiet, and whether the activity pauses or carries on (TypeScript module server/presence.ts). Pure functions over plain JSON state; the caller supplies the clock and keeps the state. Participant ids are the ids guest-identity issues; automatic participants (computer players) are always present. Presence is the one owner of pause flags (hostAbsent, allOffline, manual) and holds (look, learn); an engine derives game-clock run flags from them. Events: a request from a participant is seen; a live connection opening or closing is setLive; the application going to the background is away; time passing is refresh. Methods named PresenceApi.* are the functions of createPresenceApi(settings), which a turn engine calls.

awayAfterSeconds.description: Silence after which a participant without a live connection is absent; defaults to 30.

dropAfterSeconds.description: How long everyone counted may be absent before the activity is abandoned; defaults to 1800.

hostAbsentRule.description: pause: the activity pauses while the host is absent; defaults to pause.

PartialPresenceSettings.description: Any of the settings; the rest take their defaults.

HoldKind.description: look: looking at a result; learn: reading a guide.

counts.description: Takes part in the activity (counted for allOffline).

live.description: A live connection is open: present without making requests.

lastSeen.description: Last request or live change, milliseconds since the epoch.

misses.description: Decisions taken for this participant while absent; cleared when seen again.

pausedSince.description: Wall time the activity first paused, or null while not paused.

holds.description: Participants whose hold stops the clock for everyone, in the order taken.

PresenceState.description: Plain JSON state; the caller keeps it and supplies the clock.

running.description: While false, holds end and the pause flags are left alone.

roundOver.description: A result is showing; a look hold ends without one.

activeIds.description: The people still in the activity; their counts follow it.

PresenceApi.description: createPresenceApi's object: the settings and the PresenceApi.* methods, with the settings bound. Operations that change nothing return the same object they were given.

additionalProperties.description: Function one of the PresenceApi.* methods.

enum: awayAfterSeconds must be a whole number of at least 1
dropAfterSeconds must be a whole number of at least 1
hostAbsentRule must be pause or continue
